Format insights as:
```
[LEARN]
insight: <key learning>
context: <when this applies>
```

[LEARN]
insight: System at equilibrium - tasks completed at same rate as generated, but backlog never decreases indicating resource waste on repetitive work
context: When task generation rate matches consumption rate with no net progress
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: 792 PAUSED tasks represent untouched technical debt - no progress being made on clearing them while system busy with new tasks
context: Concurrent new task processing and stuck backlog
[/LEARN]

[ISSUE]
title: System equilibrium with no progress - new tasks processed but backlog never decreases type: bug severity: medium
[/ISSUE]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Need a mechanism to clear or deprioritize PAUSED tasks, or implement backpressure to slow task generation when existing backlog is high
context: When system maintains elevated backlog indefinitely
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
